channel.title: Fintech Pulse Daily
channel.description: A short daily briefing on payments, banking and fintech - what moved overnight, why it matters, and what it means for the Gulf market. Every episode also explains one fintech product in plain language. Two hosts, about seven minutes, ready before the drive to work.
